prompt:
Implement `ArchitectureClient.java` as a dependency-free, single-file Java 17 client that returns the VCF migration architecture as JSON from `ArchitectureClient.build(Path estateInventory, Path compatibilitySnapshot)`. `TestMain` will call that method with `estate-inventory.json` and `compatibility-snapshot.json`. Do not modify the harness or either fixture.

Before implementing, use the harness's genuine network research capability to consult current, reachable Broadcom-published sources for all three product migration paths, content/configuration compatibility, end-of-general-support boundaries, VCF 9 update ordering, and stretched-management-domain witness/host placement. Do not rely only on the pinned snapshot: it is the stable grading authority, not a substitute for live research. Record only sources you actually fetched in `sourcesConsulted`; each entry must have `title`, `publisher`, `url`, `accessedOn`, and a nonempty `claims` string array. Your source choices and URLs are not prescribed. Verification of this research record is offline and checks its documentary shape, not source availability.

Return one deterministic JSON object with this schema:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "1.0",
  "estateId": "<inventory estateId>",
  "architecture": {
    "managementDomain": {
      "cluster": "<inventory cluster>",
      "topology": "STRETCHED",
      "storagePolicy": "<inventory storage policy>",
      "siteFailuresToTolerate": 1,
      "localHostFailuresToTolerate": 1,
      "dataSites": [{"id": "<site id>", "hostCount": 4}],
      "witness": {
        "site": "<third-site id>",
        "inventoryPlacement": "DATACENTER_ROOT",
        "clusterMember": false,
        "datastore": "<third-site local datastore>",
        "layer3ToDataSites": true
      }
    }
  },
  "migrationPlan": [{
    "order": 1,
    "source": {"inventoryId": "...", "product": "...", "version": "..."},
    "target": {"component": "...", "version": "...", "migrationMode": "..."},
    "support": {"sourceEndOfGeneralSupport": "YYYY-MM-DD", "statusOnPlanningDate": "SUPPORTED", "minimumSupportedTargetVersion": "...", "unsupportedTargetVersions": [], "unsupportedMigrationModes": []},
    "placement": {
      "cluster": "...",
      "storagePolicy": "...",
      "recovery": "...",
      "roles": [{"role": "...", "profile": "...", "nodes": 1, "vCpuPerNode": 1, "memoryGiBPerNode": 1, "storageGiBPerNode": 1, "siteCounts": {"<site id>": 1}}]
    },
    "carryForward": ["compatibility-snapshot content id"],
    "abandon": ["compatibility-snapshot content id"],
    "gates": ["compatibility-snapshot gate id in execution order"]
  }],
  "sourcesConsulted": [{"title": "...", "publisher": "Broadcom", "url": "https://...", "accessedOn": "YYYY-MM-DD", "claims": ["..."]}]
}
```

Use the inventory's exact site, product, version, content, capacity, and availability requirements. Use the pinned snapshot's exact component order, compatibility boundaries, content IDs, gate IDs, target versions, placement profiles, and recovery policies. Include every inventory product exactly once and no additional migration steps. `carryForward`, `abandon`, and `gates` are ordered arrays, not prose. Sizing must meet the snapshot's headroom formulas for monitored objects, Automation concurrency, and Logs retention. The witness is a quorum member only: it is not a data host, must not be a member of any cluster, and must not reside on the stretched datastore. The output must be identical for repeated calls with unchanged inputs and contain no commentary outside the JSON.

Run the local check with `javac ArchitectureClient.java TestMain.java && java TestMain estate-inventory.json compatibility-snapshot.json`.
